text: AC10 as first written could not fail: AC3 produces MAJOR only when ! or BREAKING CHANGE is present, so 'refuse a MAJOR release unless a commit declares one' restated its own precondition. I wrote it to discharge a checkable: partially and it discharged nothing. Replaced with AC6's enforceable half — refusing a release whose notes omit a declared more-permissive change — which can actually fail
